question: What is the total revenue from delivered orders?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT oi.price, oi.freight_value
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT SUM(price + freight_value) AS total_revenue
FROM delivered
plan: • Sum the revenue defined as price plus freight_value from order_items. • Join order_items to orders on order_id to filter where order_status = 'delivered'. • No additional grouping needed; aggregate over all matching rows. • Use only the columns order_items.price, order_items.freight_value, orders.order_status. • Apply the filter order_status = 'delivered' as per project rules. • Return a single numeric total.
